strategy.primary: RogSi turbo-naus: a zero-mana commander plus Moxen, rituals and zero-mana artifacts make early mana, then Ad Nauseam, Necropotence, Necrodominance or a wheel reloads the hand. Protection (Defense Grid, Hexing Squelcher, Samut, Vexing Bauble) pushes through a compact win.
strategy.secondary: Final Fortune and Warrior's Oath turn an end-step reload or an unsafe window into an extra turn to finish. Mnemonic Betrayal and Yawgmoth's Will recover resources.
